goal: Add a controlled Usage Beta profile that separates real-project usability from repository-global readiness and validate it through one Character Clip Studio surrogate run.
acceptance_criteria: Usage Beta defaults to codex_surrogate while an explicit live request never silently falls back.
Goal fidelity, runnable behavior, core capability, primary user path, and delivery are the only project-level hard gates.
Any failed hard gate yields NEEDS_REWORK; any unevaluated hard gate yields BLOCKED; all five PASS despite global limitations yields PASS.
Usage Beta PASS never changes formal acceptance, release_ready, commercial_ready, packaging, or delivery authority.
One real Character Clip Studio run uses the existing canonical surrogate, compiler, scheduler, evidence, and packaging route.

quality_metrics.measure: five hard gates backed by real project evidence
quality_metrics.method: deterministic evaluator tests and real-run receipts

quality_metrics.measure: Usage Beta status changing release/global truth
new agent, scheduler, executor type, or authority

prevention: Project the existing evidence instead of defining a second acceptance system
assurance: Test status precedence, global limitation separation, mode selection, no fallback, and release truth
control: Run provider-free tests before the real surrogate run and stop at its earliest real blocker
improvement: Select the next change only from the real run's primary blocker

interface_expectations: Codex conversation remains the user-facing entry and local_packager remains the only delivery exit
codex_surrogate responses still pass through the canonical compiler and ProviderJob boundaries
Usage Beta is a read-only product status projection with no formal acceptance authority

feedback: The Usage Beta entry, five-gate evaluator, status separation, surrogate default, explicit-live preservation, and authority boundaries passed scoped regression.
The real Character Clip Studio run reached canonical GoalSpec PASS and consumed design and Agent Build ProviderJobs with zero live Provider or network calls.

The run stopped honestly at USAGE_BETA_BLOCKED because a managed generation job remained STARTING for a nonexistent PID and the formal entry refused a safe resume; no candidate or downstream project evidence was claimed.
Repository Formal Quick timed out at 300.049 seconds after pytest displayed approximately 10 percent progress, without a completed failure/error count.

worked: A thin evidence projection made repository-global limitations non-blocking without weakening any project hard gate.
The canonical surrogate compiler rejected two insufficient planning proposals and admitted the third only after exact grounding and preservation were satisfied.
did_not_work: Managed generation resume recorded a stale STARTING job with a nonexistent process and deduplicated the next resume, preventing candidate materialization.
experiments: Make the next real-usage-selected increment reproduce and fix only stale managed-job liveness/recovery, then resume the same canonical project if identity remains valid.
